case: Custom enum text and SQL NULL parameter inference in COALESCE and array_append expressions
contract: A text parameter is inferred as the custom enum in both COALESCE($1, enum_column) and COALESCE(enum_column, $1); the second position is consumed when the source enum cell is SQL NULL.
A SQL NULL parameter is inferred as the enum in both COALESCE argument positions; the first position falls back to the column, and the second remains SQL NULL for a SQL NULL source cell.
A text parameter appended to ARRAY[enum_column] is independently inferred as the enum element type and produces a custom enum array.
Text and SQL NULL parameters appended to ARRAY[enum_column] are inferred as the enum element type and preserve their value/NULL in the native enum array.
An invalid label is refused with PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 22P02 through both COALESCE and array_append parameter contexts.
PostgreSQL pg_typeof assertions verify scalar and array result types; source rows remain unchanged.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_enum_parameters_infer_in_coalesce_and_array_append -- --include-ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other direct query-parameter contexts, enum session/search_path configurations, deeper domain chains, additional parameter types at depth 64 and other custom/native cases remain open.
